title: Spouse Additions Released with a Disability Compensation Dependency Claim
content:
In a Disability Compensation dependency release, the spouse addition is:

1. the spouse addition plus the spouse aid-and-attendance addition, for each spouse, when the most recent spouse addition on the claims is marked as needing aid and attendance;
2. nothing, when the claims record no spouse;
3. one spouse addition for each spouse recorded on them, otherwise.

The spouses counted are the spouse additions recorded on the award's most recent dependency claim. The most recent spouse addition is the one with the latest effective date. The amounts are those of the award's own tier, and for a month priced from the 100 percent tier they are the 100 percent tier's spouse addition of 220.30 and spouse aid-and-attendance addition of 201.41.

**Cases (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating), months at the award's own tier)**

| Claims record | Most recent spouse addition marked as needing aid and attendance | Spouse amount each month |
|---|---|---|
| One spouse | Yes | 66.09 plus 60.42, that is 126.51 |
| One spouse | No | 66.09 |
| No spouse | — | Nothing |

For a month priced from the 100 percent tier, the first row would be 220.30 plus 201.41, that is 421.71.
